title: TOEIC Reading Part 7 — Reading Comprehension
instruction: For each question, choose the best answer.

groups.passage:
Mark Davis [10:14 A.M.]: Hi Sarah, is the main conference room available at 2:00 P.M. for the budget meeting with the regional VP?
Sarah Jenkins [10:16 A.M.]: It was booked by the IT team until 3:00 P.M., but they just moved their session to Room 4B. So yes, it's free now.

MEMORANDUM
To: All Employees, Veritas Headquarters
From: Facilities Management
Date: September 5
Subject: Updated Waste Sorting Procedures

Effective Monday, September 10, Veritas Consulting is upgrading its office recycling system. Color-coded disposal bins will be placed in all breakrooms and near elevator lobbies. Blue bins are designated for paper and cardboard, green bins for plastics and aluminum cans, and gray bins for organic food waste.

Please note that confidential documents containing client financial records must NOT be thrown into blue bins; they must be disposed of in the locked shredding consoles located next to the printing stations. Thank you for helping us achieve our corporate sustainability goals.

questions.question: What is the primary focus of the memorandum?
questions.explainAnswer: The memorandum announces updated procedures for sorting and disposing of office waste.

questions.question: Where should confidential documents be placed?
questions.explainAnswer: The memorandum states that confidential documents must be disposed of in locked shredding consoles.

To: All Department Heads <dept-heads@veritasconsulting.com>
From: Sarah Jenkins, Chief Financial Officer <s.jenkins@veritasconsulting.com>
Date: August 14
Subject: New Electronic Expense Reporting Protocol

Dear Team,

Starting September 1, Veritas Consulting will officially transition to the ConcurExpense digital platform for all corporate reimbursement requests. Paper-based expense forms will no longer be accepted by the accounting department after August 31.

To ensure a smooth transition, all employees must complete a mandatory 30-minute online training module on how to scan receipts and categorize corporate card transactions. The training portal will be accessible via the employee intranet starting August 18.

Please ensure that everyone in your respective divisions completes the module no later than August 28. If your team members experience any technical issues during registration, please contact the IT Helpdesk at extension 4402.

Thank you for your cooperation in modernizing our administrative processes.

Best regards,
Sarah Jenkins
CFO, Veritas Consulting

SAN JOSE, CA — SolarTech Innovations, a leader in high-efficiency photovoltaic panels, announced today that it will invest $45 million to construct a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Austin, Texas.

The new 150,000-square-foot facility is expected to create over 350 clean energy jobs in engineering, assembly, and logistics over the next two years. Construction is slated to begin in October, with commercial production anticipated to commence by December 2027.

'Expanding our manufacturing footprint in Texas allows us to meet the soaring demand for residential solar solutions across North America,' stated Elena Rostova, CEO of SolarTech Innovations. Qualified candidates interested in employment opportunities are encouraged to visit www.solartechinnovations.com/careers.

Customer Review: Grand Harbor Hotel & Suites
Reviewed by: Marcus Thorne (Stay Date: August 12-15)
Rating: 4.5 / 5 Stars

My business trip to Seattle was overall very pleasant thanks to the staff at Grand Harbor Hotel. The executive suite was spacious, quiet, and equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, which made working in the evening seamless. The complimentary breakfast buffet offered a great selection of fresh fruit and pastries.

The only minor drawback was that the fitness center was closed for routine maintenance on Wednesday afternoon. However, the concierge staff promptly offered me a free day pass to a partner gym down the street. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit.

groups.passage:
SAN FRANCISCO — The rapid shift toward hybrid work models over the past three years has fueled unprecedented expansion in the flexible coworking space sector. According to a new report published by Urban Real Estate Insights, flexible workspace inventory in major U.S. metropolitan areas grew by 34% in the last fiscal year alone.

Corporate employers are increasingly opting for short-term, lease-flexible hub spaces rather than binding 10-year commercial leases. [1] This shift allows companies to scale office capacity dynamically based on employee attendance patterns. [2] Consequently, major coworking providers like FlexDesk and Workspace Hub are adding high-speed fiber internet, soundproof phone booths, and premium conference amenities to cater to enterprise clients. [3] Real estate analysts predict that flexible workspaces will account for nearly 15% of total commercial office stock by 2030. [4]

questions.question: What is the main topic of the article?

options.A: Rising residential rent prices in San Francisco
options.B: New tax incentives for commercial landlords
options.D: The growth of the flexible coworking space sector

questions.explainAnswer: The article focuses on the rapid expansion and growing use of flexible coworking spaces.

questions.question: By what percentage did flexible workspace inventory grow last fiscal year?
questions.explainAnswer: The report states that flexible workspace inventory grew by 34% in the last fiscal year.

questions.question: Why are corporate employers preferring short-term leases?
questions.explainAnswer: Short-term flexible spaces allow companies to adjust office capacity according to employee attendance patterns.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? 'For example, many tech firms now allow staff to work three days in-office and two days remotely.'
questions.explainAnswer: The example describes employee attendance patterns and therefore fits best immediately after the statement about dynamically scaling office capacity at position [2].

passages.title: Skyline Eco-Lodge — Mountain Resort Packages
passages.content:
Nestled in the Cascade Mountains, Skyline Eco-Lodge offers luxury eco-friendly accommodations with solar-heated chalets, private hiking trails, and farm-to-table dining.

Resort Amenities:
• Complimentary organic breakfast served from 7:00 A.M. to 10:00 A.M.
• Guided wildlife photography tours available every Tuesday and Saturday ($40 per guest).
• Free shuttle service to and from Summit Train Station.
• On-site spa treatments (Advance booking required at least 24 hours prior).

passages.title: Customer Review
passages.content:
Reviewer: David Miller (Stay Date: July 8-11)
Rating: 5 / 5 Stars

My stay at Skyline Eco-Lodge was absolute perfection! The chalet was immaculate, and the view of the valley at sunrise was breathtaking. I took advantage of the guided wildlife photography tour on Saturday morning led by guide Thomas—we spotted bald eagles and deer!

I also booked a deep-tissue massage at the spa on Friday. The front desk staff was extremely accommodating when I called Thursday morning to reserve the treatment slot. The shuttle driver, Peter, was punctual and friendly. I highly recommend Skyline Eco-Lodge to anyone seeking a peaceful mountain getaway.

options.B: Near a beach resort in Florida

options.B: He booked the massage on Thursday morning for Friday
